article.contactDescription: The support team answers in your timezone, day or night.

categories.description: Every article is short, plain-English, and ends with what to do next. No jargon, no walls of legalese, no asking you to reboot for the third time.

channels.description: No phone trees, no twenty-minute hold music, no chatbot that loops you back to an article you already read. The support team is real, awake, and answers in your timezone.
channels.item1Description: In the bottom-right of every page. Open, type, get a real person in under a minute. The fastest way through for anything urgent.
channels.item2Description: Better for the long ones: receipts, refund discussions, anything with screenshots or links. Replies are always from a named human, not a queue address.
channels.item3Description: Pick a fifteen-minute slot, drop your number, we call. For when the issue's complicated, you're in transit, or typing on a phone keyboard is just not on.

cta.description: Have questions about coverage, installing, or a plan you've already bought? Whatever it is, message us and a few quick questions will get you to the right person. Email works too, if you'd rather.

hero.description: Search the docs, browse a category, or talk to a real human. However you ask, the answer's here.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Search: "How do I install my eSIM?"

popular.description: The questions that come up most often, pulled from across the help centre.

search.empty: Nothing matched that. Try a shorter phrase, or message the team below.

seo.description: Search the help centre, browse a category, or talk to a real person. Most questions have a one-line answer.
seo.title: Support

stats.description: Not a mission statement. The actual numbers, measured on every ticket, in every timezone we cover.
stats.item1Description: Live chat median, measured continuously across all timezones.
stats.item2Description: 82% of tickets close on the first response. The rest, with one follow-up.
stats.item3Description: Across tens of thousands of post-chat surveys.
stats.item4Description: Every first reply is a person. AI helps them; it never replies for them.
